name: claude-mods
description: Small mods for Claude Code: panes, toasts, commands and rules that change Claude Code's own interface and behaviour.

plugins.name: agent-crew
plugins.description: A side pane that shows the main agent and every subagent as little animated pixel critters dressed for their role, with status, activity, model, effort, tokens and estimated cost.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Starts each subagent on the cheapest model and effort that fits its task, never above what it would have used, and suggests a cheaper model for simple prompts.

plugins.name: arena
plugins.description: Preview: runs two Claude variants on the same task, each in its own git worktree, and follows them live with status, tokens and cost.
